description.value:
Prerequisite: 18+ Cursed Energy score

As opposed to simply forcing cursed energy into use for your abilities, you have become far more efficient in their output resulting in a dramatic boost in power.

  • When a feature allows you to spend additional cursed energy, you can spend 1 additional cursed energy. This increases to 2 CE at 6th level and 3 CE at 11th level.

  • Once per turn, you can increase the damage of an attack by your cursed energy modifier.

  • You can choose to shield yourself as a reaction, you can spend 1 CE to reduce an instance of damage by three times your Cursed Energy modifier.
